description: TunnelConfiguration.preSharedKey is the IPsec tunnel's shared secret, but the spec only tags it `writeOnly`, so the SDK types it as a plain string. The spec's own text says it is `omitted in every response`, and STACKIT's Terraform provider marks `pre_shared_key` Sensitive and offers a write-only variant (stackitcloud/terraform-provider-stackit, stackit/internal/services/vpn/connection/resource.go, read 2026-11-01). No live probe: this changes how the value is typed and logged, not what goes on the wire.
